description: Start a ShipMyForm account from an email address, with no browser. A 6-digit code is emailed to the address; verify_account with { email, code } then returns the API key. Works without authentication. Also works for an existing account (the code approves API access).

agent.description: Your name, e.g. 'Claude Code', shown in the verification email.

email.description: The user's email address. Ask for it; never invent one.

preset.description: Named scope bundle: full (everything), wiring (forms only, no submission access), readonly, triage

scopes.description: Explicit scopes, instead of a preset. Ignored where it would exceed the calling key's own scopes.

name: sign_up
title: Create an account
